title: Change Only the Bottle
tests: Tests tightly masked recolouring, checked by comparing all pixels outside the bottle against the source at matching resolution.

faults.what: The bottle is a bright, saturated grass green rather than the requested dark forest green.
The background visible through the right-hand opening in the lid handle has acquired a green tint.

judge.summary: The recolor preserves the bottle's matte appearance and geometry, but the green is too bright and spills into the handle opening.

must_haves.item: The black bottle is now forest green and still looks matte.
must_haves.why: The finish remains matte, but the color reads as bright grass green rather than dark forest green.

must_haves.item: The bottle retains its exact silhouette, position and surface details.
must_haves.why: The outline, placement, lid seams, highlights and small marks near the base appear preserved.

must_haves.item: The wooden table, background and cast shadow are unchanged.
must_haves.why: The table and cast shadow appear unchanged, but the background seen through the lid handle is tinted green.

must_haves.item: At matching resolution, comparison outside the bottle mask shows no visible alterations, allowing only encoding differences.
must_haves.why: A visible green tint affects the background within the handle opening, which is outside the bottle material.

must_haves.item: No green spill, editing halo, crop or framing shift is visible.
must_haves.why: There is green spill in the handle opening; no crop or framing shift is visible.
